title: Nourishing Creamy Kenyan Lime Wrap
description: A savory, low-fat wrap bursting with umami, creamy coconut, and zesty lime, steamed in lotus leaves for a weeknight Kenyan treat.
instructions: Rinse lotus leaves under cold water and pat them dry.
Heat a skillet over medium heat, add olive oil, and sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add diced chicken, ground cumin, smoked paprika, and cook until heated through for about three minutes.
Stir in shredded coconut and low-fat Greek yogurt, cooking for another two minutes until creamy.
Remove the pan from heat, cool the mixture to 28°C, then fold in melted dark chocolate gradually until fully incorporated.
Stir in lime juice, lime zest, and a pinch of sea salt until the filling is evenly combined.
Lay a lotus leaf flat, spoon 2–3 tablespoons of the filling onto the center, roll tightly, and secure with a kitchen twine.
Place the wraps seam side down in a steamer basket over boiling water and steam for five minutes, then serve hot.
